Subject: RE: Westrow Warehousing Submission

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the Westrow Warehousing submission! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I have a few questions before I can finalize the quote:

**Referral Items:**
- Can you confirm the construction type and year built for the warehouse location?
- What are the primary commodities stored, and are any considered hazardous materials?
- Is there an active sprinkler system? If yes, what type and when was it last inspected?
- What are the security measures in place (fencing, cameras, alarm systems)?

Once I have these details, I'll be able to work up a competitive quote for your December 2026 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
